description: Server-side request forgery in the SmartIT URL-based attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to make server-side requests to internal services and observe response information.

Stored cross-site scripting in the SmartIT work-notes feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to execute stored scripts in other users' browsers.

Stored cross-site scripting in the SmartIT attachment feature of BMC IT Service Management Suite versions 25.3.01, 25.4.01, and 26.1.01 allows authenticated users to execute uploaded script content in other users' browsers.
